text:
To resolve permission errors on mapped volumes in NAS environments like UGOS Pro, set the **`PUID`** and **`PGID`** (or **`HERMES_UID`** and **`HERMES_GID`**) environment variables when running your Docker container to match your host user and group IDs. 

For example, pass them in your Docker run command or Compose file:

```bash
docker run -it \
  -e PUID=$(id -u) \
  -e PGID=$(id -g) \
  -v /path/to/host/data:/opt/data \
  nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest
```

Alternatively, you can export or set `HERMES_UID` and `HERMES_GID` to match your host NAS user permissions.
